description: Here are 3 ad types every desire first brand should trial.  #facebookcreative #facebookadvertisingtips #metaads #facebookadstips #metaadsspecialist
transcript: If I was running an ad account for a desire first brand, here are 3 creative types that I would launch and none of them are another brand or product shop. The first is a desire ad. This is selling the lifestyle, not the product. Think of a fit check or when a girl tries on an outfit and loves the way she looks. Desire is what actually earns the click. This is your top of funnel. The second is the founder or brand ad. This can be face to camera. It can be b roll with a voiceover. This is the why behind the brand, the story behind that specific product or even the choice you almost didn't make. People don't buy from logic. They buy from belief. This is what builds trust and that middle of funnel. The third is your social proof ads. Real people, real settings. Think about that unsolicited compliment or that text from a friend that said, where did you get that from? The story she posted without tagging your brand. Proof is what closes the people that desire brought in. And of course, this is your bottom of funnel. So you can see three formats, three stages of the funnel. That is diversification, not three versions of a product shop. So remember, desire earns a click, the brand builds the trust and proof closes it. And you need all three.
